title: Bell integrated into the saucer airframe in 1944

tellings.quote: They took the rockets out, put the bell in it, and there's your flying saucer.

plain: In 1944, at the Skoda Works factory near Prague, the Nazis built a flying saucer by taking the rockets out of an airframe and fitting in "the Bell", a secret device that, in this telling, gave it a new way to fly: "They took the rockets out, put the bell in it, and there's your flying saucer." The researcher Jason Jorjani tells Michels this, crediting a work called Closer Encounters. If true, Nazi Germany would have had a working saucer before the war ended.
